follow-up time: Median 36 days (30-33 weeks gestation) and 15 days (34-36 weeks gestation)
cohort: 560 moderate-to-late preterm infants (30+(0/7) to 36+(6/7) weeks of gestation) in France
finding: The NEOBS study demonstrated that continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) was widely used in the delivery room and the less invasive surfactant administration (LISA) method was chosen for 34.4% of the surfactant administrations for the management of respiratory failure in moderate-to-late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Infants were delivered by cesarean section in 59.6% of cases.
